Introduction

IÖN (born Park Gyu-jeong,) is a South Korean music producer and DJ. He is best known as one half of the acclaimed production duo GroovyRoom, which debuted independently in 2016 and quickly rose to prominence in the South Korean hip-hop and R&B scene. In addition to his work with GroovyRoom, IÖN is also a member of the South Korean hip-hop crew Yelows Mob, a collective known for its influential role in the underground and mainstream hip-hop community.

He was previously signed to H1GHR MUSIC, a label founded by Jay Park and Cha Cha Malone, where he and fellow GroovyRoom member Lil Moshpit produced for a wide range of notable artists. In 2024, the duo departed H1GHR MUSIC to establish their own label and creative collective, AT AREA, aimed at promoting artistic independence and innovation.

That same year, IÖN officially debuted as a solo artist, expanding his musical identity beyond collaborative production. Known for his genre-blending sound, polished production style, and forward-thinking approach to music, IÖN continues to shape the evolution of Korean hip-hop and R&B as both a producer and solo musician.
